name: fretboard-renderer-vscode
description: Render guitar fretboard diagrams from lightweight YAML in fenced ```fretboard code blocks, in VSCode's Markdown preview.

fretboardRenderer.orientation.description: Direction the fretboard is drawn in.

fretboardRenderer.fretCount.description: Default number of frets to draw when a block does not specify one.

fretboardRenderer.labelMode.description: What to print inside each note dot by default.

fretboardRenderer.namingMode.description: Auto-generated title: name a chord (e.g. "Am7"), or reverse-engineer the best-fitting scale for the notes present (e.g. "A Minor Pentatonic"), flagging leftover notes as passing notes (e.g. "A Minor Pentatonic (+2)").

fretboardRenderer.chordSymbolStyle.description: Notation convention for auto-generated chord suffixes, e.g. minor: "m" / "-" / "-"; major 7th: "maj7" / "maj7" / "Δ7"; half-diminished: "m7b5" / "-7b5" / "ø7".

fretboardRenderer.omitNotation.description: Mark a chord missing an expected tone, e.g. "C(omit3)" for a bare power chord, "G7(omit3)" for a 7th voiced without its 3rd, "(omit5)" when the 5th is missing entirely. Off by default — guitarists very commonly omit the 5th, and marking every such chord would be noisy.

fretboardRenderer.showInversions.description: Show the slash-chord bass note when it's just an inversion — the chord's own 3rd, 5th, or 7th played as the lowest note (e.g. "C/E"). Off by default — real-world chord charts very often skip notating this. A bass note that isn't one of the chord's own tones (a true slash chord) is always shown regardless.

fretboardRenderer.defaultShape.description: "None" draws no outline — just the label on a borderless filled backdrop.

fretboardRenderer.nutStyle.description: How the fret-0 line is drawn.

fretboardRenderer.fretNumbering.description: "Inlay markers" shows only the standard fretboard inlay positions (3, 5, 7, 9, 12, 15, ...).

fretboardRenderer.noteSize.description: Base radius of each note dot (px). Per-note `sizeAdjust` (-5..5) nudges from this.

fretboardRenderer.labelFontSize.description: Base font size for note labels (px). Per-note `labelSizeAdjust` (-5..5) nudges from this.

fretboardRenderer.defaultTuning.description: Comma separated absolute pitches, lowest string first (e.g. E,A,D,G,B,E).

fretboardRenderer.omittedStringBehavior.description: How to render strings that are not mentioned in a block's notes.
